Description: [Happy Path] Test Case 1.1: Ban/Lock User & Verify Login
Precondition: Admin is logged in, Candidate user exists
Test Steps: 1. Find user by email\n2. Lock user\n3. Attempt to login as candidate
Expected Result: Status changes to Inactive/Banned, login fails with error for locked user

Precondition: Admin is logged in, Candidate user is locked
Test Steps: 1. Find user by email\n2. Unlock user

Description: [Happy Path] Test Case 1.3: Change Role to Mentor & Verify Login
Precondition: Admin is logged in, Candidate user exists
Test Steps: 1. Find user by email\n2. Change role to Mentor\n3. Login as candidate
Expected Result: Role changes to Mentor, user redirected to mentor dashboard on login

Description: [Happy Path] Test Case 1.4: Revoke Mentor Role
Precondition: Admin is logged in, User is Mentor
Test Steps: 1. Find user by email\n2. Change role back to Candidate\n3. Login as candidate
Expected Result: Role changes to Candidate, user not redirected to mentor dashboard
